JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 5 · The descent

Fifteen kilometres up, five minutes before the descent engine lights. You stand at the Commander's station. The braking takes eight minutes with the windows to the sky; at high gate the LM pitches forward and the valley swings into view between the massifs. Below 150 metres the computer lands you, unless you take over. Stand up for this chapter, as the crews did.

In the headset: below 150 metres A takes over (P66): the right stick tilts the LM to move over the ground, a flick of the left stick up or down changes the descent rate by 1 ft/s, A again gives it back to the computer. Touch down at under 3 m/s. Before high gate A or X runs time up to ×10; hold B to look from outside.

On this screen: drag to look, Space start or pause, T take over or give back, arrow keys tilt, [ ] descent rate, W faster, O outside, 1–4 jump.
